source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
	ACCOUNT_NUMBER
	,TRAN_DATETIME
	,ATM_BANK_ID
	,ATM_TERMINAL_ID
	,COMMAND
	,STAN
	,TRAN_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(TRAN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE
	,PARTTRAN_NUM
	,PARTTRAN_IND
	,PARTTRAN_REM
	,PARTTRAN_PART1
	,PARTTRAN_PART2
	,TRAN_AMT
	,SOURCE_APP_CODE
	,ATM_CRD_NUM
	,BILLER_CODE
	,BILR_SUBR_NUM1
	,BILR_SUBR_NUM2
	,FREE_TEXT1
	,FREE_TEXT2
	,FREE_TEXT3
	,FREE_TEXT4
	,FREE_TEXT5
	,TPS_USER
	,TPS_TRANREF
	,TPS_ACCNO
	,TPS_ACCNAME
	,TPS_TRAN_RMKS
	,TPS_TRAN_DESC
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,BANK_ID
	,LAST6_ACC_NUM
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM D360.STG_DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE
